# Environment — flipova.github.io

This repository reads its configuration from the **workspace vault**, never from a
file inside the repository. Nothing `.env*` is expected here, and nothing of the sort
may ever be committed.

## Run it with the vault injected

```bash
corral run --env dev --repo flipova.github.io -- <your command>
```

## Or generate the files, outside the repository

```bash
corral vault gen --repo flipova.github.io --all
```

```
<workspace>/.env/flipova.github.io.<env>        variables
<workspace>/.secrets/flipova.github.io.<env>     secrets
```

Environments: dev, staging, prod. A key scoped to *this repo* wins over a *shared* one
of the same name.

## Manage them

```bash
corral vault resolve --repo flipova.github.io --env dev     # what is in effect, and where it comes from
corral vault set MY_KEY value --env dev --repo flipova.github.io
corral vault check                                # the security audit
```
